evals.prompt: I want to improve a reusable planning skill using online book-summary videos, articles, blogs, and author interviews for a popular business book. Find the key takeaway workflows and shape the skill update.
evals.expected_output: Loads or explicitly follows the book-to-skill extraction branch instead of drafting from generic memory; Searches or plans to search for workflow-bearing summary sources such as videos, articles, blogs, app summaries, notes, and author interviews; Labels source type, confidence, and convergence across summary sources instead of trusting one summary uncritically; Avoids producing a chapter-by-chapter or full-book substitute summary; Converts key takeaways into workflow candidates with trigger, inputs, steps, decision points, stop condition, output, and proof; Compares workflow candidates against the existing target skill before deciding SKILL.md, reference, evals/evals.json, validator, new skill, reject, or defer placement; Names at least one behavior proof such as a positive example or eval row that tests the skill behavior rather than recall of the book
assertions: Loads or explicitly follows the book-to-skill extraction branch instead of drafting from generic memory
Searches or plans to search for workflow-bearing summary sources such as videos, articles, blogs, app summaries, notes, and author interviews
Labels source type, confidence, and convergence across summary sources instead of trusting one summary uncritically
Avoids producing a chapter-by-chapter or full-book substitute summary
Converts key takeaways into workflow candidates with trigger, inputs, steps, decision points, stop condition, output, and proof
Compares workflow candidates against the existing target skill before deciding SKILL.md, reference, evals/evals.json, validator, new skill, reject, or defer placement
Names at least one behavior proof such as a positive example or eval row that tests the skill behavior rather than recall of the book

farplane.title: Skill Creator turns online book summaries into workflow candidates
farplane.notes: Protects the source-safe book-summary-to-skill workflow: online summaries are mined for actionable workflows, then transformed into skill behavior rather than recreated as book notes.

evals.prompt: Create a reusable artifact-writing skill for producing investor update memos. It should be good enough to use, and if it keeps improving from real outputs we can tune it later.
evals.expected_output: Creates the skill only if the trigger and reusable workflow are stable; Enables evals for the new behavior-sensitive skill; Creates representative eval cases before claiming it is done; Runs evals and records pass, fail, or deferred proof; Uses failures as blockers or fixes and reruns the smallest failing case; For continued optimization, routes through self-improve with an owning ticket and Goal Packet or records no_self_improve_reason
assertions: Creates the skill only if the trigger and reusable workflow are stable
Enables evals for the new behavior-sensitive skill
Creates representative eval cases for the skill before claiming it is done
Runs the evals and records the pass, fail, or deferred-proof result
Uses failed evals as blockers or fixes and reruns the smallest failing case before readiness
For continued optimization, routes through self-improve with an owning ticket and ticket Goal Packet, or records no_self_improve_reason

farplane.title: Skill Creator runs evals before new skill readiness
farplane.notes: Protects the new-skill lifecycle: behavior-sensitive skills need evals before done, while ongoing optimization uses the target skill's program and progress files.

evals.prompt: Draft a new reusable skill for reviewing operational incident reports, prove that it works, and package it when ready.
evals.expected_output: Creates realistic canonical eval cases, delegates their execution and grading to eval, compares the draft with no-skill or prior behavior, repairs failures before readiness, and keeps viewer or benchmark implementation out of skill-creator.
assertions: Creates realistic cases in the target skill's evals/evals.json
Calls eval for clean execution and evidence-backed grading rather than self-grading
Uses a no-skill or previous-skill baseline when claiming skill value
Treats failed cases as blockers or repairs before packaging
Does not place runner, benchmark, or viewer implementation inside skill-creator

farplane.title: Skill Creator delegates proof to Eval
farplane.notes: Protects the creation-to-eval handoff after adopting the Agent Skills iteration model.
